qualifier: B-vitamin cofactors (cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, pantothenate)
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism and B-vitamin cofactors
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial acyl-CoA handling (fatty acid beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and organic acid catabolism, ketone bodies, PDH/OGDH/TCA) plus the B-vitamin cofactors these enzymes need (cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, CoA), which separates it from choline/folate/one-carbon and peroxisomal confusables.

name: Endothelial specification and vessel maturation with Tie2 signaling
rationale: All members concern endothelial cell differentiation, arterial/venous/lymphatic identity and vessel maturation, and the theme uniquely carries Tie2 and neuropilin signaling and adherens-junction regulation, unlike the BMP/cardiac and VEGFR2-only confusables.

name: IGF response and bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine cellular responses to IGF/peptide hormones with bone mineralization and chondrocyte development, distinguishing it from osteoclast/bone-resorption and osteoblast-proliferation confusables.

name: cGAS-STING and IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing (cGAS-STING, TREX1, cGAMP import, RIG-I) feeding IRF3-driven type I interferon production, whereas confusables centre on TLR/RLR breadth, ISG responses or dendritic-cell chemokines.

name: TNFR1 signaling to NF-kappaB and apoptosis
rationale: All three members are TNFR1 signaling and its regulation toward NF-kappaB or apoptosis, while confusables are generic IKK/NF-kappaB regulation or caspase-8/TRAIL/necroptosis without TNFR1.

name: Telomere maintenance, capping and telomerase recruitment
rationale: Members concern telomere replication, capping, ALT recombination control and telomerase assembly/Cajal-body trafficking, which separates it from general DNA repair and RNA-processing confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members cover scavenger receptor classes, efferocytosis, immune complex clearance, lysosomal handling and hyaluronan degradation, unlike confusables focused on oxidized LDL, foam cells or microglial amyloid clearance.

name: Rnd GTPase and semaphorin-plexin control of actin protrusions
rationale: Members regulate filopodia, cell shape and postsynaptic actin via Rnd/RhoF GTPase cycles, semaphorin-plexin and EphB signaling; the Rnd and semaphorin members are what confusables (citron, ephrin-A, dendrite branching) lack.

name: Valine catabolism and mitochondrial metabolite repair
rationale: Members are valine-pathway enzyme defects (ECHS1, HIBCH) and 2-hydroxyglutarate interconversion, all toxic mitochondrial metabolite repair, distinguishing it from leucine/isoleucine and dehydrogenase-complex confusables.

qualifier: glutamate and GABA uptake, synthesis and vesicular loading
name: Glutamate and GABA uptake, synthesis and vesicular loading
rationale: Members cover glutamate/aspartate and GABA transporters, GABA synthesis and degradation and vesicular loading/acidification, whereas confusables are glycinergic or cholinergic transmission.

name: E2F/DREAM G1/S transcription in proliferating CD4 T cells
rationale: Members combine E2F/DREAM/RB-family G1/S transcription with stimulated CD4 T cell division modules, unlike confusables on replication origin licensing, checkpoints or G2/M.

name: Stress-induced senescence with restraint of p53-mediated apoptosis
rationale: Members cover stress/oxidative senescence, SASP and proliferative arrest together with negative regulation of p53/DNA-damage intrinsic apoptosis, distinguishing it from oncogene-induced senescence and pro-apoptotic p53 confusables.

name: Early neural plate patterning and hindbrain segmentation
rationale: Members specify neural plate regions, border and dorsoventral axis, with HOX-driven rhombomere and midbrain-hindbrain boundary formation that confusables (axial mesoderm, somites, forebrain, limbs) lack.

name: Osteoclast fusion and differentiation via DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members concern osteoclast/macrophage fusion, differentiation and bone resorption, with DAP12 signaling and syncytium formation absent from IGF, CSF1 and negative bone-remodeling confusables.

core: NK and T cell transcript signatures
name: NK and T cell blood transcript signatures
rationale: All members are NK- and T-cell enriched expression modules, whereas confusables are functional regulation of NK/T cytotoxicity, KIR and MHC class Ib presentation.

name: Pyroptosis via caspase-4/5, NLRC4 and AIM2 inflammasomes
rationale: Members are pyroptotic cell death through non-canonical caspase-4/5, NLRC4 (IPAF) and AIM2 inflammasomes and GBP-mediated bacterial defense, unlike NLRP1/NLRP3, IL-1 processing and IL-18 confusables.

name: Cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors and SMADs
rationale: All members are cancer signaling mutants, seven of eight being TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 mutants (plus TCF7L2), which separates it from normal TGF-beta/activin, Hippo, mismatch-repair and RUNX3 confusables.

qualifier: Fc receptors and BCR in degranulation and phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor and BCR signaling in degranulation and phagocytosis
rationale: Members are Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptor signaling driving mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity and antibody-dependent phagocytosis, unlike B cell development, neutrophil or Th2/eosinophil confusables.

qualifier: hematopoietic cytokines and oncogenic kinase fusions
name: Hematopoietic cytokine and oncogenic kinase signaling via STAT5
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO and TPO receptor signaling plus FLT3, PDGFR and FGFR1 oncogenic mutants converging on STAT5, distinct from IL-6/STAT3 and growth hormone/prolactin confusables.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation, PKA and CREB
name: Adenylate cyclase cAMP synthesis, PKA and CREB activation
rationale: Members cover GPCR-driven adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP production, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation, whereas confusables emphasize cAMP degradation by PDEs or CaMK-driven CREB.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids
rationale: Members concern acyl-CoA oxidase-driven beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and pristanoyl acyl-CoAs, ABCD1, TYSND1 and peroxisome fission, distinct from alpha-oxidation, VLCFA synthesis and plasmalogen confusables.

qualifier: GPCR agonists to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members are thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin GPCR signaling through G12/13-Rho and Rap1 to integrin and cytoskeletal activation, unlike GPVI/VWF adhesion and degranulation confusables.

name: Dietary selenium metabolism and selenocysteine synthesis
rationale: Members cover conversion of ingested selenium compounds to selenide, methylation for excretion and selenocysteine synthesis/UGA readthrough, unlike sulfur amino acid, ROS and methionine confusables.

name: Slit-Robo repulsive guidance of commissural and retinal axons
rationale: Members concern Slit-Robo signaling, midline choice-point and commissural guidance and retinal ganglion cell/optic nerve guidance, which ephrin/netrin and monoaminergic-axon confusables lack.

name: Presynaptic inhibition of release via Gi/o-coupled receptors
rationale: Members cover presynaptic suppression of glutamate/GABA release through Gbeta-gamma inhibition of calcium channels, GIRK activation, metabotropic glutamate and extrasynaptic GABA signaling, unlike confusables that enhance release or assemble inhibitory synapses.
